title: A Drug Lord's Zoo Left Colombia With Wild Hippos 🦛
caption:
Four hippos escaped a drug lord's zoo and took over a river 🦛
Wait for the ending 👀

True story. Pablo Escobar kept four hippos at his private zoo in Colombia. After his death the hippos were left behind, escaped into the Magdalena River and bred. Estimates now put them at around 200, and experts warn there could be 1,000 by 2035.
Save them or cull them? 👇
first_comment: Four hippos in the 1980s, around two hundred now. Cull them or keep them? 🦛👇
